prompt:
Rewrite snippets/order-summary-rows-2.liquid so it renders an order summary table with sensible defaults. Inputs (all top-level variables, always supplied): - rows: array or null. Each element is an object that always has the keys label (string or null) and amount_cents (non-negative integer or null). - currency: string or null. - empty_text: string or null. Rules: 1. CUR = currency stripped of leading/trailing whitespace; if currency is null or empty after stripping, CUR = "USD". CUR is HTML-escaped on output. 2. If rows is null or has zero elements, output exactly
MSG
, where MSG = empty_text stripped, or "No items" when empty_text is null or empty after stripping; MSG is HTML-escaped. No total row in this case. 3. Otherwise output , then one row per element in input order: (single space between CUR and AMOUNT). LABEL = label stripped, or "Item" when label is null or empty after stripping; HTML-escaped. A null amount_cents counts as 0. 4. AMOUNT formats cents as whole units, a dot, then exactly two digits: 12999 -> 129.99, 500 -> 5.00, 7 -> 0.07, 10 -> 0.10, 0 -> 0.00, 100000 -> 1000.00. No thousands separators. 5. After the item rows output where TOTAL is the sum of all amounts (null counted as 0) formatted the same way, then
LABELCUR AMOUNT
TotalCUR TOTAL
. Output must contain no whitespace or newlines between tags and no other text. HTML escaping converts & < > and " to entities. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/order-summary-rows-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
